�🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)
John Doe is a delivery driver navigating a post-apocalyptic world where dangerous gangs, heavily armed vehicles, and ruthless killers control the roads. When he takes on a high-stakes delivery mission, he must cross a wasteland where one wrong turn could be his last.
Along the way, he encounters Sweet Tooth, a terrifying masked killer who drives a deadly ice cream truck and brings pure chaos wherever he goes. With danger around every corner, John must rely on his instincts to survive a world where trust is rare and everyone has something to hide.
Packed with explosive car chases, brutal battles, and dark comedy, Twisted Metal turns the open road into a deadly game of survival.
Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
